_comment: Page routing rules. The first rule whose conditions all hold chooses the method; otherwise 'default'.
Conditions: <metric>_lt, _le, _gt, _ge. Metrics: chars, text_area, image_area, image_count,
garbage_ratio, rotation, size_vs_a4. Areas are fractions of the page (0-1).
Change 'version' whenever you change rules, so new decisions are stored separately.

rules.name: image covers most of the page with little text over it

flags.name: image-dominant page (figure, map, seismic section or scan)
mixed: digital text over a large image
